faqs.q: Does HDFC Millennia cashback work on Swiggy orders under ₹150?
faqs.a: HDFC’s current MITC uses complete ₹100 transaction blocks. A qualifying direct Swiggy purchase below ₹100 earns no CashPoints under that rule. A purchase of ₹100–₹149 can earn on the first ₹100 if the merchant ID is eligible and there is cap remaining.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia cashback real cashback or reward points?
faqs.a: You earn HDFC CashPoints. You can redeem them for statement credit at ₹1 per CashPoint, subject to a 500-point minimum, a 3,000-point calendar-month redemption ceiling and ₹50 plus tax per redemption. Other redemption routes have different values.

faqs.q: Can I get the HDFC Millennia fee waived?
faqs.a: HDFC lists ₹1,000 plus applicable tax for renewal. Its fee schedule says to spend over ₹1 lakh in the year before renewal for the waiver. Confirm qualifying spend and the renewal period on your account. The separate quarterly milestone is a different benefit.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia better than Amazon Pay ICICI?
faqs.a: For eligible Amazon.in goods, Amazon Pay ICICI can earn 5% with Prime or 3% without it, as Amazon Pay balance. Millennia’s 5% tier also covers nine other listed merchants, but they draw from the same calendar-month cap. Compare both on your own basket after membership and redemption costs.

faqs.q: What happens after I hit the ₹1,000 monthly cap?
faqs.a: The named-merchant and other eligible purchase buckets each have a 1,000-CashPoint calendar-month cap. When you exhaust the 5% bucket, further purchases in that bucket do not switch to 1%. Purchases eligible for the separate 1% bucket can still earn until its own cap. Use the settlement date to track each bucket.

capMath.title: Regalia earning and redemption limits
capMath.body:
Track three limits separately: up to 50,000 points earned per statement cycle, up to 2,000 points earned on groceries per calendar month, and up to 50,000 points redeemed for eligible flights and hotels per calendar month.

At ₹0.50 per point, the maximum points value toward those travel bookings in a calendar month is ₹25,000. Each booking also has a 70% limit on the portion payable with points. Statement cashback uses a separate calendar-month redemption cap and is worth up to ₹0.15 per point.
